Format and Validate Survey Data for DOAS

Source: R/doas_data.R
doas_data.Rd

Transforms raw field data from sector-wide, group-level long, or observer-sighting long formats into a validated, sector-level `doas_data` data frame ready for inspection prior to running doas.

Usage

doas_data(
  data,
  format = c("sector", "group", "sighting"),
  sector = "sector_id",
  count = NULL,
  groups = "detected_groups",
  both = "groups_both",
  obs1 = NULL,
  obs2 = NULL,
  seen_by = NULL,
  observer = "observer",
  group_id = "group_id",
  primary_obs = NULL,
  count_rule = c("max", "mean", "obs1"),
  do_sectors = NULL,
  all_sectors = NULL,
  covariates = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A data frame containing survey records.

format

Character string specifying the input data structure: - "sector" (default): One row per survey sector (wide format). - "group": One row per detected animal group (long format). - "sighting": One row per observer sighting record, linked by group_id (long format).

sector

Character name of the sector identifier column (default "sector_id").

count

Character name of the individual count column (default "total_count" for format = "sector", or "group_size" for format = "group" and "sighting").

groups

Character name of the total detected groups column for format = "sector" (default "detected_groups"). Optional for DO sectors if both, obs1, and obs2 are supplied.

both

Character name of the column for groups seen by both observers in format = "sector" (default "groups_both"). Optional if groups, obs1, and obs2 are supplied.

obs1

Character name of the Observer 1 column (default "groups_obs1" for format = "sector", or binary indicator "obs1" for format = "group").

obs2

Character name of the Observer 2 column (default "groups_obs2" for format = "sector", or binary indicator "obs2" for format = "group").

seen_by

Optional character name of a single categorical column in format = "group" indicating which observer(s) detected the group (values: "both", "obs1", "obs2", "block"). If provided, used instead of binary obs1/obs2 columns.

observer

Character name of the observer ID column when format = "sighting" (default "observer").

group_id

Character name of the unique group ID column when format = "sighting" (default "group_id").

primary_obs

Value in the observer column identifying the Primary Observer (Observer 1) when format = "sighting" (default 1, also matches "1", "obs1", "Obs1" if NULL).

count_rule

Character rule for reconciling group size when both observers record a sighting of the same group_id in format = "sighting": "max" (default), "mean", or "obs1".

do_sectors

Optional vector of sector IDs that received Double Observer (DO) surveys. Strongly recommended for format = "group" and format = "sighting" so DO sectors where Observer 2 happened to detect 0 groups are not misclassified as Block sectors.

all_sectors

Optional vector of all surveyed sector IDs (including empty sectors with 0 detections).

covariates

Optional character vector of sector-level covariate column names to retain.

Value

A validated sector-level data frame of class c("doas_data", "data.frame") with columns sector_id, survey_type, total_count, detected_groups, groups_both, groups_obs1, groups_obs2, mean_group_size, and any requested covariates.

Examples

# 1. Group-level long format (1 row per detected group)
raw_groups <- data.frame(
  valley = c("A", "A", "A", "B", "B", "C"),
  size   = c(12, 5, 8, 10, 4, 15),
  who    = c("both", "obs1", "obs2", "both", "obs1", "block"),
  effort = c(8, 8, 8, 6, 6, 5)
)
df_sec <- doas_data(
  raw_groups,
  format = "group",
  sector = "valley",
  count = "size",
  seen_by = "who",
  do_sectors = c("A", "B"),
  covariates = "effort"
)
print(df_sec)
#> DOAS Validated Survey Data: 3 sectors (2 DO, 1 Block) | 54 total individuals in 6 groups
#> --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#>   sector_id survey_type total_count detected_groups groups_both groups_obs1
#> 1         A          DO          25               3           1           1
#> 2         B          DO          14               2           1           1
#> 3         C       Block          15               1          NA          NA
#>   groups_obs2 mean_group_size effort
#> 1           1        8.333333      8
#> 2           0        7.000000      6
#> 3          NA       15.000000      5
